neet_phy_u09_t07_1.working: From PV = nRT = N k_B T with n = N/N_A, k_B = R/N_A.

neet_phy_u09_t07_4.working: Avogadro's number = 6.022e23 mol^-1 (III); Loschmidt number = 2.69e25 m^-3 (I); molar volume at STP = 22.4e-3 m^3 mol^-1 (IV); Boltzmann constant = R/N_A (II).

neet_phy_u09_t07_5.working: A is Avogadro's law, so it is true. B: 6.022e23 / 22.4e-3 m^3 = 2.69e25 m^-3, true. C: N = (m/M)N_A, true. D is false because the molar volume is 22.4 L = 22.4e-3 m^3, not 22.4 m^3. E is false because k_B = R/N_A.
